workload.semantics: Each synthetic query retains 29 of 32 source features and replaces three, producing exact Jaccard similarity 29/35 just above the 0.8 target threshold.
workload.cache_policy: Dataset generation, signature construction, index construction, and the first query pass are included. Filesystem cache state is not reset between persistent build and reopen.
workload.correctness: Exact Jaccard ground truth is evaluated for every configured query; scalar and batch candidates must match; persistent and lazy candidates must match the in-memory index.

smoke.description: Fast correctness and bundle-validation profile for local development and CI.

scale-100k.description: Standard committed scaling profile and weekly scheduled campaign.

scale-1m.description: Dedicated-runner profile for the one-million-item scaling envelope.

scale-10m.description: Manual dedicated-host profile; run only after the 1M preflight confirms memory and disk headroom.

scale-100m-methodology.description: Planning profile only. Extrapolate measured 10M memory and persistent bytes/item before approving a 100M single-index run.
